channel.description: Insights on classical Ayurveda, constitutional healing, Panchakarma, and mindful living from RIDDHI Ayurveda Clinic, Rajkot.

item.title: Soup Is Not Just a Japanese Trend: The Ancient Science of Liquid Foods in Ayurveda
item.description: Long before miso soup became a wellness buzzword, Suśruta Saṃhitā engineered a meticulous science of liquid foods: Maṇḍa, Peyā, Vilepī, pulse soups, and nourishing broths.
item.author: dr.vijay@riddhiayurveda.online (Dr. Vijay Telang & Dr. Minakshee Vijay Telang)

item.title: Śrāvaṇa Krishna Ṣaṣṭhī: Looking at a Traditional Observance Through Ayurveda
item.description: Why does digestive fire weaken during the monsoon? Explore the medical rationale behind Varṣā Ṛtucaryā and how ancient Indian fasting customs reflect digestive physiology.
item.author: dr.vijay@riddhiayurveda.online (Dr. Vijay Telang & Dr. Minakshee Vijay Telang)

item.title: Ayurveda for Beginners: Why Traditional Wisdom Still Matters in the Age of AI
item.description: We are living in an era of artificial intelligence, but health is more than technology. Learn why traditional Ayurvedic wisdom, Hetu-Lakṣaṇa-Cikitsā, and personalized Panchakarma matter today.
item.author: dr.vijay@riddhiayurveda.online (Dr. Vijay Telang & Dr. Minakshee Vijay Telang)
